description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Bear" on Ayula to "Beast"
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 4.
